title: Musk Oxen Crash Heads Hard Enough to Hear a Mile Away

scenes.text: Two musk oxen crash head first, and you can hear it a mile away.
scenes.keywords: musk ox bulls charging head butt

scenes.text: Each bull weighs up to 800 pounds.
They back up 50 yards or more, then charge at top speed.
The hit is like a car slamming a wall at 17 miles per hour.
A horn four inches thick and three more inches of skull protect the brain.
Then they do it again, up to 20 times. Listen for a mile.

description:
Two musk ox bulls can crash heads hard enough to be heard from a mile away.
The impact is compared to a car hitting a wall at 17 miles per hour, and they can repeat it up to 20 times.
Would you stand a mile away or closer to hear it?
first_comment: Which animal do you think has the hardest head?
